subject: rt-dym
title: RT.DYM.------POL.P.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-36 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's distinction between two transfer conditions: one 'natural' (connected to spiritual and vibrational factors interconnecting with progressional information) and one 'manufactured' (the result of flaws in the western philosophical and vibrational position). (C)RT-DYM (the concept of reality dynamics) is crossed with POL-P (political policies): the question is what reality-dynamics produces when crossed with political-policies, when the transfer-cycle is being manufactured rather than naturally occurring. INFO-DE-B (information degree basis) branches from the main line and leads to IST-PT (isolated particulars). CN-INFO (controlled information) also branches from the main line and leads to JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) and on to CRT (criticism). RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) branches from the main line and carries C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) and AFTD (affinity tendencies), which leads to ATT (attitude).
